Here's what the table looks like in 'spreadsheets' and what it looks like in PS, as well as the table in csv. So, I can't find a way to add a team logo, so I would ask you if someone knows how to explain it to me! Thanks! 

 PL_table.csv

 Correct answer Lumigraphics 

 What on Earth do you mean by "I created the table in spreadsheets"? We are talking about Photoshop. Is this a Photoshop file? Or do you want to put photos in your spreadsheet? Photoshop doesn't have a spreadsheet function, if you are talking about a Photoshop file then you would need to manually recreate your chart each time.

 If you are doing this in Excel (for example) then this is the wrong forum to ask for help.

 First, you need to redo your table, one club on each row, and you need to ad one column for the logo. You can only see one data row at a time in your PSD file. you, CSV, have to have the data separate with an [ ,] or [tab]. Be sure to spell the variable name correctly, no spaces both in the spreadsheet and destination file in photoshop
